reviews_verbatim.author: Frank Baez
reviews_verbatim.text: We did a full renovation of the kitchen with One Stop Cabinet Shop and the service provided exceeded our highest expectations. Ray is very creative and experienced designer who combined with great care and attention to details.

reviews_verbatim.author: Jonathon Fitzgerald
reviews_verbatim.text: Working with Ray was enjoyable and easy. He does very high-quality custom work. He built and installed our kitchen cabinets and also did a smaller project for us in our laundry room, all of which turned out great.

reviews_verbatim.author: Tom Brennen
reviews_verbatim.text: After careful consideration of 8 estimates and becoming educated in the process of cabinet refacing and cabinet installation, One Stop Cabinet Shop became the number one company I felt most comfortable contracting with.

reviews_verbatim.author: danny frastai
reviews_verbatim.text: We hired One Stop Cabinets to redo our kitchen and we cannot say enough about what an incredible job they did. Our kitchen looks even better than we imagined it would.

reviews_verbatim.author: Zina Mckenzie
reviews_verbatim.text: After more than 4 estimates from Cabinet Renovation Companies, We decided on One Stop Cabinet Shop. I found this team of Father and Son to have the experience, expertise and knowledge.
